notes.title: Alpha playtest: Version 0.49. Last major update before public playtest release!
notes.content:
improvements and bug fixes:
Removed the old spawn locations for bird sounds.

Adjusted the glass material to be more realistic.

Lowered default mouse/joystick sensitivity by 60%.

Fixed the upscale resolution percentage falling back to 100% if the number input was invalid. Now, it falls back to the last valid render resolution, or 76% if there wasn't a valid render resolution input since last paused.

Added a % sign at the end of the render resolution percentage in the graphics menu.

Fixed various ray traced shadow problems related to nanite tessellation.

Layout improvements and grammar improvements to settings menus.

Minor CPU optimisations related to saving, changing, and loading options.

Fixed game needing to restart before deleting save file takes any affect.

Fixed motion blur being on despite motion blur settings saying its off.

Updated the dlss plugin from dlss 3.7.10 to 3.7.20 ( better edge stability and more effective anti-aliasing. )

Deleted a few unused levels, which should lower overall game size.

You can now press right click while in the first part of the pause menu to un-pause... again. ( I removed the feature because it had a large bug I couldn't fix in the update that turned the options menu into its own widget instead of having 2 options menus for the main menu and pause menu )




New features:
Added an option in accessibility options for enabling and disabling world rendering while paused.

Added mouse/joystick sensitivity option in controls.

Added FSR 3.1 upscaling/anti-aliasing support!

Added Xe-SS 1.3.1 upscaling/anti-aliasing support!

Implemented better performance and quality scaling with ray traced shadows. ( pretty much just added higher quality options and separated 2 of the settings that used to be applied together from 1 option )

Added the basics of a collectables system.

Completely rebuilt the save game system to add support for multiple save files and managing them in-game.

Added experimental options mode toggle, which basically removes some limitations on some options and adds the ability to type console commands.

Replaced the timer based footstep system with a distance based system. This should make things feel and sound a bit more natural, and it might lower cpu usage.

Implemented a function that checks if your GPU supports ray tracing, and if it doesn't

Added basic support for DLSS Ray Reconstruction ( proper support will come once nvidia updates the plugin )

notes.title: alpha playtest: version 0.48.8
notes.content:
improvements and bug fixes:

refactored the code for saving the players character information ( location, health etc )

fixed the bug where if you falling velocity was high enough, you wouldn't take any fall damage.

increased the max amount of fall damage you can take from 40% to 85%

continued to optimise shader count and memory usage by replacing main materials with material instances

moved the objective text from the side of the screen to the top middle so the player is more likely to notice it

fixed the bug where the pause menu wouldn't behave correctly if you used one of the 3 methods of closing it, and then used a different one ( for example, you pressed continue, reopened the pause menu, and then closed it with right mouse click. )

separated the options menu from the main menu and the pause menu, and now they both share a single options menu. this will mainly just make things less confusing for me as the developer, but for you as a player, it will make the options menu truly consistent, and will prevent many future bugs and issues.

added a lot more trees to the landscape of the first level. ( please test performance with this change. its definitely going to be slower in most areas of that level, but i need to make sure its not too much slower )

notes.title: alpha playtest: version 0.48.1 hotfix
notes.content:
softened the grass textures mipmaps in the first level. this stops the anti aliasing and upscaling from having to work as hard, which reduces noise, artifacts, and softness. ( yes, softening textures can make it look sharper and less noisy when upscaling and using temporal anti-aliasing )

added specular reflection to the grass. ( i forgot i set it to 0 awhile ago, so... oopsy )

optimised the mesh of light switches ( the curve had 4 unnecessary triangles )

gave more detail to the first levels landscape so its less boring, and its easier for me to effectively plan out the gameplay.

put the first levels sun and sky in a blueprint instead of persistent level so it is easier to change them. for players, this will be a CPU optimisation, because there's no longer code that checks a certain variable every 4 secs to decide whether the sun and sky should change. it just checks once-twice, when you first spawn into the level, and if you complete a certain objective.

notes.title: alpha playtest: version 0.48
notes.content:
fixes and improvements:
fixed the lighting issue in the facility building in the first level where the lighting would be unnaturally bright when hardware lumen is turned off ( the problem was the ceiling model wasn't being taken into consideration in the software lumen scene, so i just broke up the ceiling into cubes instead of having a single model for the entire ceiling. very slightly less performance optimised but its worth it for people who don't have ray tracing capable GPUs )

lowered ultra quality upscaling setting from 78% to 76% ( it now matches DLSS ultra quality internal resolution percentage )

removed FXAA from the anti aliasing options ( it complicates editing the anti aliasing options and every other option is better than FXAA)


new features:
added fall damage.

some levels now have their own unique player save. This means that if your game saved at some point in the first level ( first level for example ), whenever you go back to the first level, you will spawn with the same health, location, and rotation you last saved with while in that level, even if you saved in another level before going back to the first one.

if you hold down sprint and then crouch or laydown, you will now go down to the corresponding heights/positions faster.

added DLSS support! ( DLSS Super Resolution, DLAA, NIS, and DLSS frame generation. DLSS SR and FG versions are both 3.7.10 )

settings for controlling the camera smoothness ( basic version. i am aware of the bug where it doesn't show the selected option after closing the pause menu and re-opening it )

tags.balance_change: - lowered ultra quality upscaling setting from 78% to 76% ( it now matches DLSS ultra quality internal resolution percentage )

tags.bug: - removed FXAA from the anti aliasing options ( it complicates editing the anti aliasing options and every other option is better than FXAA)

- if you hold down sprint and then crouch or laydown, you will now go down to the corresponding heights/positions faster.

notes.title: alpha playtest: version 0.43
notes.content:
bug fixes and improvements:
fixed a bug where the next objective woulnt properly set and save if you left the game within 5 secs after the " welcome back! " text comes up in the first level, which would cause you to have no objective once you continued.

improved various pieces of text in options and objectives.

fixed unintended behaviour with the objective from _#######_ that would show up if you interacted with the locked door before finding the keycard and before recieving the other version of the same objective from ****** in the first level.

fixed you being able to receive the same goal over and over again by walking in and out of the trigger. ( look inside the house? goal )

fixed the issue where if you saved the game after unlocking the door in the first level, leave and continue, the door is locked again and youre stuck inside.

in the first level, specular lighting from the sun was decreased by 10X the intended amount ( i forgot i set it like that awhile ago because the grass was " too shiny" for my liking in that moment ) so that has been restored to the intended amount. it mostly benefits the visuals of leaves on trees and more glossy materials.

increased camera shake while sprinting and walking and improved immersion of the same camera shakes.

fixed the bug where vsync would not be on by default on first load

fixed the bug where the fps limit would not say its set to 120 on first load ( even though it is )

fixed the bug where the lens flare would be low quality, and at the same time it would say its not on in the graphics settings



new features:
when paused, the pause menu tells you your current objective.

new objectives.

game now automatically closes when you delete your main game save data 



notes: im trying a new ( hopefully better ) objective system, so please test objectives in as many ways as you can think of, and report any bugs or issues in the pinned discussion. look out for set objectives not saving or loading properly, objectives being weird, etc. ( this new system should stop objectives interfering with eachother in ways that are unintended. with the old system, when i added more objectives, i noticed that when some objectives got completed, they caused other objectives to complete. anyway, i couldnt fix that issue while keeping the same system.

FYI, when i say " objectives" i mean the system that tells you your next " goal " to progress through the main story, and also the system that manages and saves in your main save file which goals you have completed, which ones you dont, and what is allowed to happen in the level if those objectives have been completed or not.
